# -----------------------------------------
## Combined chart: diatom diagram + DCA1 ##
# -----------------------------------------

# ------ DCA calculation -------

```{r, Baiau Superior}

# Initial long-format data frame (raw data):
ba_sup_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Raw_unified_data_frames/baiau_superior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

# ------------ Pre-treatment -------------

# Species matrix: samples x species
ba_spp_mtx <- ba_sup_raw_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species_ID),
         !is.na(sample),
         !is.na(No),
         No > 0) %>%
  group_by(sample, Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(No = sum(No), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Species_ID,
    values_from = No,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(ba_spp_mtx) <- ba_spp_mtx$sample     # 'sample' as rownames
ba_spp_mtx$sample <- NULL                         # Remove sample column

# Convert counts to relative abundances:
ba_rel_mtx <- decostand(ba_spp_mtx, method = "total") * 100

# ------------ DCA -------------

# Detrended Constrained Analysis: 
ba_dca <- decorana(ba_rel_mtx)    # Full inventory

# ------------ Explore the DCA -------------

# Total inertia
ba_total_inertia <- ba_dca$totchi

# Eigenvalues
ba_eigenvalues <- ba_dca$evals

# Percentage of total inertia explained
ba_dca_variance <- tibble(
  axis = names(ba_eigenvalues),
  eigenvalue = as.numeric(ba_eigenvalues),
  total_inertia = ba_total_inertia,
  percent_inertia = 100 * eigenvalue / total_inertia
)

ba_dca_variance

```

```{r, Baiau Inferior}

# Initial long-format data frame (raw data):
ba_inf_raw_df <- read.csv("Select your directory/Raw_unified_data_frames/baiau_inferior_raw_unified_data_frame.csv", sep = ";")

# ------------ Pre-treatment -------------

# Species matrix: samples x species
bain_spp_mtx <- ba_inf_raw_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Species_ID),
         !is.na(sample),
         !is.na(No),
         No > 0) %>%
  group_by(sample, Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(No = sum(No), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Species_ID,
    values_from = No,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(bain_spp_mtx) <- bain_spp_mtx$sample     # 'sample' as rownames
bain_spp_mtx$sample <- NULL                         # Remove sample column

# Convert counts to relative abundances:
bain_rel_mtx <- decostand(bain_spp_mtx, method = "total") * 100

# ------------ DCA -------------

# Detrended Constrained Analysis: 
bain_dca <- decorana(bain_rel_mtx)    # Full inventory

# ------------ Explore the DCA -------------

# Total inertia
bain_total_inertia <- bain_dca$totchi

# Eigenvalues
bain_eigenvalues <- bain_dca$evals

# Percentage of total inertia explained
bain_dca_variance <- tibble(
  axis = names(bain_eigenvalues),
  eigenvalue = as.numeric(bain_eigenvalues),
  total_inertia = bain_total_inertia,
  percent_inertia = 100 * eigenvalue / total_inertia
)

bain_dca_variance

```

# ------ Diatom diagram plus the DCA1 --------

# Before the diagram

```{r, Baiau Superior}

# ---------- Extract species scores -----------

# Species scores:
ba_dca_species <- scores(
  ba_dca,
  display = "species",
  choices = 1:4
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("Species_ID")

# Add abundance and occurrence information:
ba_species_summary <- ba_rel_mtx %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -sample,
    names_to = "Species_ID",
    values_to = "rel_abundance"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Species_ID) %>%
  summarise(
    max_abundance = max(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abundance = mean(rel_abundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    occurrence = sum(rel_abundance > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ba_dca_species_info <- ba_dca_species %>%
  left_join(ba_species_summary, by = "Species_ID")        # Join DCA scores with abundance information

# --------------- Define & select species candidates ------------------

# Parameters:
min_candidate_abundance <- 2  # Species must reach at least 2% in one sample
dominant_threshold <- 5  # Dominant background taxa: max abundance >= 5%

n_negative <- 5
n_intermediate <- 5
n_positive <- 5

#1. Classify all species:
ba_dca_species_info <- ba_dca_species_info %>%             # All species classification!
  mutate(
    DCA1_position = case_when(
      DCA1 <= quantile(DCA1, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Negative",
      DCA1 >= quantile(DCA1, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE) ~ "Positive",
      TRUE ~ "Intermediate"
    ),
    abundance_class = case_when(
      max_abundance >= 10 ~ "Dominant",
      max_abundance >= 5  ~ "Abundant",
      max_abundance >= 2  ~ "Common",
      TRUE ~ "Low abundance"
    )
  )

#2. Define candidates for DCA1-informed selection:
ba_dca_species_candidates <- ba_dca_species_info %>%
  filter(max_abundance >= min_candidate_abundance)

#3. Select DCA1-informative taxa:
ba_species_dca1_selected <- bind_rows(           # Only taxa selected because they represent the DCA1 gradient!
  
  # Strong negative DCA1 taxa
  ba_dca_species_candidates %>%
    arrange(DCA1) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_negative) %>%
    mutate(selection_role = "DCA1-informative",
           DCA1_group = "Negative DCA1 end"),
  
  # Intermediate DCA1 taxa, prioritising abundance
  ba_dca_species_candidates %>%
    filter(
      DCA1 >= quantile(DCA1, 0.40, na.rm = TRUE),
      DCA1 <= quantile(DCA1, 0.60, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(max_abundance), desc(occurrence)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_intermediate) %>%
    mutate(selection_role = "DCA1-informative",
           DCA1_group = "Intermediate"),
  
  # Strong positive DCA1 taxa
  ba_dca_species_candidates %>%
    arrange(desc(DCA1)) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_positive) %>%
    mutate(selection_role = "DCA1-informative",
           DCA1_group = "Positive DCA1 end")
  
) %>%
  distinct(Species_ID, .keep_all = TRUE)

#4. Add dominant background taxa:
ba_species_dominant_selected <- ba_dca_species_info %>%     # Abundant taxa that were not selected by DCA1 but are important!
  filter(
    max_abundance >= dominant_threshold,
    !Species_ID %in% ba_species_dca1_selected$Species_ID
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    selection_role = "Dominant background",
    DCA1_group = DCA1_position
  )

#5. Final selected species:
ba_species_selected_final <- bind_rows(        # Final simplified list for the tidypaleo diagram!
  ba_species_dca1_selected,
  ba_species_dominant_selected
) %>%
  arrange(DCA1)

ba_species_selected_final

```

# Combined plot

```{r, Baiau Superior}

# The chart have two panels: selected diatom species and DCA1. 

# ---------------------------------------------
# ---------- Define common settings -----------
# ---------------------------------------------

# Depth:
depth_limits <- c(95.05, 0.50)
depth_breaks <- seq(0.50, 95.05, by = 20)
custom.depth.breaks <- seq(0.50, 95.05, by = 10)

# Age:
ba21_ages <- read.csv("Select your directory/Ages_tidypaleo/ba_ages_tidypaleo.csv", header = TRUE, sep = ";")  # Calibrated ages

ba.age.model <- age_depth_model(.data = ba21_ages, #An age-depth model is necessary. 
                         depth = ba21_ages$depth, 
                         age = ba21_ages$mean, 
                         age_min = ba21_ages$min, 
                         age_max = ba21_ages$max 
                         )

age.range <- tidypaleo::predict_age(
  ba.age.model,
  c(0.50, 95.05)
)

age.breaks <- seq(
  floor(min(age.range) / 500) * 500,
  ceiling(max(age.range) / 500) * 500,
  by = 1000
)

age.breaks <- c(0, 1000, 2000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7000)   # Select specific ages!

# -------------------------------------
# ---------- Species panel ------------
# -------------------------------------

# Define the species order using DCA1:
ba_species_order_dca1 <- ba_species_selected_final %>%   # Species with negative DCA1 end associated with species with positive DCA1 end
  arrange(DCA1) %>%
  pull(Species_ID)

ba_diagram_df <- ba_sup_raw_df %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_abundance = No / sum(No, na.rm = TRUE) * 100
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(Species_ID %in% ba_species_order_dca1) %>%
  mutate(
    Species_ID = factor(Species_ID, levels = ba_species_order_dca1)
  )

# Species-only plot: keep depth axis on the left
ba_species_panel <- ggplot(
  ba_diagram_df,
  aes(x = rel_abundance, y = mean.depth)
) + 
  geom_col_segsh() + 
  scale_y_reverse(
    name = "Depth (cm)",
    breaks = depth_breaks,
    limits = depth_limits,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) + 
  facet_abundanceh(
    vars(Species_ID),
    grouping = NULL,
    rotate_facet_labels = 90
  ) + 
  labs(
    title = "Baiau Superior", 
    x = "Relative abundance (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 0,vjust = 0,size = 12,face = "italic"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 9),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

ba_species_panel

# -------------------------------
# ---------- DCA panel ----------
# -------------------------------

# Create the DCA1 panel:
ba_dca_scores <- scores(    # Extract the site/sample scores from the DCA object
  ba_dca,
  display = "sites",
  choices = 1:4
) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample")

ba_dca_depth <- ba_dca_scores %>%          # Add depth information to DCA1 scores
  mutate(sample = as.integer(sample)) %>%
  left_join(
    ba_sup_raw_df %>%
      distinct(sample, mean.depth, mean.age),
    by = "sample"
  )

# Plot panel: no y-axis labels
ba_dca_panel_mid <- ggplot(
  ba_dca_depth,
  aes(x = DCA1, y = mean.depth)
) +
  geom_path(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5, colour = "black") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = 0,
    linewidth = 0.3,
    linetype = "dashed",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_y_reverse(
    breaks = depth_breaks,
    limits = depth_limits,
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "DCA1",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.border = element_rect(colour = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0.5, 
                              face = "bold"
                              )
  )

ba_dca_panel_mid

# ---------- Combine panels -----------

ba_species_panel <- ba_species_panel +
  scale_y_depth_age(ba.age.model, 
                    name = "Depth (cm)",
                    age_name   = "Age (cal yr BP)",

    # Primary y (depth):
    trans        = "reverse",                     # replaces scale_y_reverse()
    breaks       = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 12),      # major ticks every 10 cm

    # Secondary y (age) – optional:
    age_breaks   = seq(0, 7600, by = 1000)       # adjust to your range
  )

ba_species_dca_combined <- ba_species_panel | ba_dca_panel_mid    
  
ba_species_dca_combined <- ba_species_dca_combined +
  plot_layout(widths = c(6, 1)) 

ba_species_dca_combined

```
